name: Saint Hilarion Monastery/ Tell Umm Amer
description: These ruins sit on the coastal dunes of Nuseirat in the Gaza Strip, where Saint Hilarion founded one of the Middle East's earliest monasteries in the 4th century. It began as a scatter of solitary hermits and grew into a communal monastery, the first in the Holy Land. Its position on trade routes between Asia and Africa made it a busy Byzantine hub. The site is on the List in Danger.
